title: Smoke on the Stairs
persona:
- Age and background: 38. Poland; Gdańsk courier dispatch clerk. Plays cooperative platformers with friends on weekends and occasional phone puzzles.
- HF temperament: no HF exposure and no recorded temperament. Treat her as a person who weighs concrete likes against concrete limits, and who says what she saw in play in her own words.
- Likes: knowing what a control will do before she presses it, short sittings she can pause, timing and coordination that she can improve at, a short situation she can read once and act on.
- Dislikes: long text before the first action, small touch targets, repeating a step she already understood, screens that ask for more than she can see a reason for.
- Play habits: Plays platformers on a desktop with friends at weekends and puzzles on her phone in short breaks. Reads the first screen, tries the most obvious control, and checks what changed. Says plainly when something does not suit her.
- Personal diary: empty. No play history of any kind. Only observed sessions can add history.
